title: AI permissions
description: The user's AI permissions record (m9-ai-powers §1.1, settings key ai.permissions) and the result of ai.getPermissions / ai.setPermissions (§1.2). The record is the defaults every new task's grant is built from.

revision.description: 0 until the first save; ai.setPermissions must send the current value (else -32002) and bumps it.

set.description: false until the user has finished the permissions page once.

history.description: get_report_history, get_benchmarks (the ask's own benchRunId stays readable)

names.description: app and device names; off = aliases (share.names)

checks.description: every read-only diagnostic available on this PC

scripts.description: requires changes = fix (the host refuses it otherwise, -32602)

admin.description: m9 §17.1: administrator rights. Absent reads as false (a record stored before it, and ai.setPermissions from a page without the row); never pre-selected. The host writes it on every record and keeps it whatever available.admin says.

available.description: What the selected provider can do with the record. tools: false for an explain-only account. web: computed by §6.4 (unknown until then). scripts: false until §5 ships. admin (m9 §17.1): the --enable-admin-actions flag; false = administrator rights are not available in this version.

permissions.description: see and do with every field. version, revision and set may be echoed back; the host owns them.
